else

  echo "$DELETABLE" | xargs -r ls -lah

  echo "$DELETABLE" | xargs -r sudo rm -f

  FREED_BYTES=0

AFTER=$(df -h | awk '$6=="/" {print $5" used of "$2" total"}')

import os
b=int(os.environ.get('FREED_BYTES', '0'))
print(round(b/1024/1024,2))
PY
)
SUMMARY="Removed files older than 30 days: $(echo "$DELETABLE" | tr '\n' ' ' | sed 's/ $//'); freed approx ${FREED_MB} MB."

# Append summary to HANDOFF.txt
if [ -f /var/log/agent-platform/HANDOFF.txt ]; then
  echo "$SUMMARY" | sudo tee -a /var/log/agent-platform/HANDOFF.txt >/dev/null
else
  echo "$SUMMARY" | sudo tee /var/log/agent-platform/HANDOFF.txt >/dev/null
fi

echo "\n== Summary =="
echo "$SUMMARY"

# Show final directory listing and disk
ls -lah /var/log/agent-platform | sed -n '1,240p'
df -h | sed -n '1,50p'

else

"]
